Noncommercial local adaptation · Block A

GeoWind2Plan: Mission-Time 3D Urban Wind Prediction for Energy-Efficient UAV Planning

Shaoxiang Qin, Yucheng Zhao, Fuyuan Lyu, Di Zhou, Jiachen Yao, Xue Liu, Anima Anandkumar, Liangzhu Leon Wang, Xiongye Xiao

arXiv Code

Fast, corridor-localized 3D urban wind prediction makes wind-aware UAV energy planning practical at mission time.

This demo computes everything on your own device. Its speed depends on your hardware.

GPU in use
Ground truth on
Routes tested on saved CFD winds (each takes hours to simulate and serves as ground truth).
Ground truth off
Allows any wind speed and direction. No CFD evaluation.
CFD wind
This local edition includes Block A at 4 m/s and 0° only. Other winds have no CFD evaluation.
Local changes
Single-city scope, independent building-surface clearance checks, export and provenance. Original model and browser algorithms by the GeoWind2Plan authors.

Developed by DUAL Lab (Shaoxiang Qin and Xiongye Xiao)
